lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਧਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਗ ਹੀਰ ਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: udadh gur gahir ga(n)bheer bea(n)t har naam nag heer man milat liv laaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Guru is an Ocean, deep and profound, infinite and unfathomable. Lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name, you shall be blessed with jewels, diamonds and emeralds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਮਲ ਸਰਸ ਕਰਤ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਪਰਸ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: phun guroo paramal saras karat ka(n)chan paras mail duramat hirat sabad gur dhyaaeeai ||
lines.translation: And, the Guru makes us fragrant and fruitful, and His Touch transforms us into gold. The filth of evil-mindedness is washed away, meditating on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਛੁਟਕੰਤ ਸਦ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੵਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਿਖ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit paravaah chhutaka(n)t sad dvaar jis gyaan gur bimal sar sa(n)t sikh naaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar flows constantly from His Door. The Saints and Sikhs bathe in the immaculate pool of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naam nirabaan nidhaan har ur dharahu guroo gur gur karahu guroo har paaeeai ||3||15||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart, and dwell in Nirvaanaa. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru; through the Guru, the Lord is obtained. ||3||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap ma(n)n re ||
lines.translation: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸੁਰ ਅਸੁਰ ਗਣ ਤਰਹਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sev siv sidh saadhik sur asur gan tarahi tetees gur bachan sun ka(n)n re ||
lines.translation: Serving Him, Shiva and the Siddhas, the angels and demons and servants of the gods, and the thrity-three million gods cross over, listening to the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਿਤ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phun tarahi te sa(n)t hit bhagat gur gur karahi tario prahalaad gur milat mun ja(n)n re ||
lines.translation: And, the Saints and loving devotees are carried across, chanting Guru, Guru. Prahlaad and the silent sages met the Guru, and were carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਹਿ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਰਸ ਅੰਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tarahi naaradaad sanakaad har guramukhahi tarahi ik naam lag tajahu ras a(n)n re ||
lines.translation: Naarad and Sanak and those men of God who became Gurmukh were carried across; attached to the One Name, they abandoned other tastes and pleasures, and were carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੁ ਬੇਨਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਨ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: daas benat kahai naam guramukh lahai guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap ma(n)n re ||4||16||29||
lines.translation: This is the prayer of the Lord's humble slave: the Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, chanting Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind. ||4||16||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: siree guroo saahib sabh oopar ||
lines.translation: The Great, Supreme Guru showered His Mercy upon all;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karee kripaa satajug jin dhroo par ||
lines.translation: in the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, He blessed Dhroo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਰੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sree prahalaad bhagat udhareea(n) ||
lines.translation: He saved the devotee Prahlaad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਮਲ ਮਾਥੇ ਪਰ ਧਰੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hast kamal maathe par dhareea(n) ||
lines.translation: placing the Lotus of His Hand upon his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਲਖੵਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh roop jee lakhyaa na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Unseen Form of the Lord cannot be seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal saranaaee ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas and seekers all seek His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke bachan sat jee dhaarahu ||
lines.translation: True are the Words of the Guru's teachings. Enshrine them in your soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਸ੍ਤਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam deh nistaarahu ||
lines.translation: Emancipate your body, and redeem this human incarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਹਾਜੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur jahaaj khevat guroo gur bin tariaa na koi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Boatman. Without the Guru, no one can cross over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad prabh paaeeai gur bin mukat na hoi ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, God is obtained. Without the Guru, no one is liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak nikat basai banavaaree ||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak dwells near the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin lahanaa thaap jot jag dhaaree ||
lines.translation: He established Lehnaa as Guru, and enshrined His Light in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਹਣੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lahanai pa(n)th dharam kaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: Lehnaa established the path of righteousness and Dharma,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਭਲੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: amaradaas bhale kau deeaa ||
lines.translation: which He passed on to Guru Amar Daas, of the Bhalla dynasty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਸੋਢੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਪੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin sree raamadaas sodhee thir thapy ||
lines.translation: Then, He firmly established the Great Raam Daas of the Sodhi dynasty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਪੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam akhai nidh apy ||
lines.translation: He was blessed with the inexhaustible treasure of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੵਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਲਹੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: apy har naam akhai nidh chahu jug gur sevaa kar phal laheea(n) ||
lines.translation: He was blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Name; throughout the four ages, it is inexhaustible. Serving the Guru, He received His reward.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦਹਿ ਜੋ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dahi jo charan saran sukh paavahi paramaana(n)d guramukh kaheea(n) ||
lines.translation: Those who bow at His Feet and seek His Sanctuary, are blessed with peace; those Gurmukhs are blessed with supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paratakh deh paarabraham suaamee aad roop pokhan bharana(n) ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Body is the Embodiment of the Supreme Lord God, our Lord and Master, the Form of the Primal Being, who nourishes and cherishes all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਲਖ ਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣੰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur gur sev alakh gat jaa kee sree raamadaas taaran tarana(n) ||1||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, the True Guru; His ways and means are inscrutable. The Great Guru Raam Daas is the Boat to carry us across. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਿਤਿ ਚਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih a(n)mrit bachan baanee saadhoo jan japahi kar bichit chaao ||
lines.translation: The Holy people chant the Ambrosial Words of His Bani with delight in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d nit ma(n)gal gur darasan saphal sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: The Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world; it brings lasting bliss and joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saphal ga(n)gaa gur darasan parasan param pavitr gate ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world, like the Ganges. Meeting Him, the supreme sacred status is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਹਿ ਜਮ ਲੋਕੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਗੵਾਨਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeetahi jam lok patit je praanee har jan siv gur gyaan rate ||
lines.translation: Even sinful people conquer the realm of Death, if they become the Lord's humble servants, and are imbued with the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਘੁਬੰਸਿ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਰਥ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੰਛਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raghuba(n)s tilak su(n)dar dasarath ghar mun ba(n)chhahi jaa kee sarana(n) ||
lines.translation: He is certified, like the handsome Ram Chander in the house of Dasrath of the Raghwa dynasty. Even the silent sages seek His Sanctuary.
